title: 第7章 撞大运了第8章 贝尔加莫
content_zh:
第七章 撞大运了
距离新赛季开始只有三天的时间了，迪甘很清楚自己的处境，即使是在青年队里，面对着一帮比他小了两三岁的毛孩子，他得到的也大半都是蔑视的目光，很显然那场比赛已经铸就了他的传奇。
青年队主管艾拉尼奥好像也将他当成了透明人，这也难怪，人家手底下可是有二三十号天才球员，哪里顾得上他这个垃圾。
迪甘倒也坦然，每天人家训练的时候，他就在一边跑圈，用青年队中的头号天才帕罗斯基小盆友的话来说，他这个傻大个子是对足球失去了希望，打算转行去练马拉松了。
别人爱说什么就说什么，迪甘只要知道自己在干什么就OK了，经过这些天的锻炼，他感觉自己已经慢慢的适应了这具身体，虽然速度恢复到前世那百米10.8秒，是不大可能了，但是维持在11秒是没什么问题。
这段时间，AC米兰也在极力向别的球队推荐着他，似乎是觉得他留在米兰内洛都会污染了空气一样，迪甘知道，这些都是卡卡帮的忙，他希望自己这个做弟弟的足球生涯能够继续下去。
只可惜哪怕是丙2级别联赛的球队，都不愿意给他一个试训的机会，所有的回复一律都是：倒找我钱，老子都不要那个废物。
迪甘已经打定了主意，他不会将自己的大好年华扔在AC米兰的青年队，五年的合同，等到他逃出去的时候，基本上就可以告别足球生涯了，到时候他拿什么向儿子吹嘘？
嘿！小子！老爹当年可是穿着AC米兰的队服踢过球，而且还出了一个大丑。
算了吧！要是那样的话迪甘情愿断子绝孙，也不愿意他的儿子将来把卡卡当成偶像，即使卡卡是他的哥哥。
迪甘已经盘算好了，等到冬歇期的时候，他就去世界各地的球队寻找试训的机会，相信到了那个时候，恢复前世的水平应该不成问题了。
他不是没想过要留在这里，留在米兰，通过自己的努力征服这里，但是那真的很难，这段时间米兰青年队打了三场比赛，他甚至连大名单都没有进过，哪怕是队内的分组对抗，都没有他的份，很显然所有人都已经对他不报任何期望了。
当然，除了卡卡。
“罗德！我这里有一个机会，佩吉亚愿意给你一个试训的机会，如果你能通过他们的考核，新赛季你就是他们的人了！”
卡卡对迪甘说出这番话的时候，脸上带着隐隐的兴奋，这段时间为了迪甘的事情，他不知道求了多少人，现在总算是有了结果。
“佩吉亚！？那是什么球队！？”
卡卡一愣，接着有些为难的说：“是~~~~~~~丙2级联赛的一支球队，他们上个赛季刚刚降级，这支球队还是很有实力的！”
迪甘一笑，道：“他们好像之前拒绝过了，这次怎么会良心发现？”
卡卡当然不能对迪甘说，那支球队现在的老板是加图索的父亲，那样只会更加伤害迪甘的自尊心。
迪甘见卡卡不说话，也猜到了一些：“谢谢你！里卡多！我知道这段时间因为我的事情，你求了很多人，不过，我还是要拒绝，那支球队配不上我！”

卡卡闻言，毫无预兆的就发火了，皱着眉道：“罗德！做人不能好高骛远，你现在的处境自己应该清楚，当然，我相信你的实力，但是即使你是贝利，是济科，是苏格拉底，你也需要一个展现自己的机会，难道你就准备一直这么等下去，等米兰给你机会，罗德！清醒一下，这么多年了，米兰的教练什么时候向下看过，我非常希望我们能够在一支球队并肩作战，所以，出去走走，去外面闯出一番明堂，让AC米兰不得不重视你！”
迪甘没有像上次和博斯克那样，和卡卡争执起来，他能感觉到卡卡是真的在关心他，不过他还是摇头道：“里卡多！听我说，我说过了要走自己的路，尽管这条路再怎么艰难，也请让我自己走下去！”
卡卡知道就算是再怎么说下去也没用了，迪甘变了，不再是当初那个对他言听计从的弟弟了，他现在有些后悔，如果当初不是他做主把迪甘带来意大利的话，或许他已经在圣保罗闯出了明堂。
就在所有人都以为迪甘已经完了，他接下来的时间只能在米兰内洛厮混，直到他的合同到期，或者干脆是等到卡卡离开。他将会像吸血鬼一样，每年从AC米兰拿走一百万欧元的年薪，却什么都不干。
可就在这个时候，事情居然峰回路转了，看着助手递过来的传真，加利亚尼简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
“亚特兰大要租借迪甘，租借卡卡的弟弟！？”
加利亚尼的眼神里满是疑惑，知道对手点头，他才相信自己的眼睛没有看错。
这是为什么？
加利亚尼的大光头里充满了问号。
难道那个迪甘有什么过人之处，AC米兰虽然有自己的骄傲，但是有一点他却不得不佩服亚特兰大，那就是贝尔加莫的训练营，那里几乎集中了整个意大利最优秀的一批青年才俊，帕齐尼，蒙托利沃，拉扎里，这些名字吸引了无数人的注意力。
相比较之下AC米兰的青训营最近这些年却是乏善可陈，自打五小虎之后，他们就再也没有为一线队补充过任何新鲜的血液了。
揉了揉鼻梁，加利亚尼道：“答应他们的租借申请，不用和他们讨价还价，迪甘的薪水全都由我们来支付，对了！顺便去青年队那边，通知迪甘，他可以去贝尔加莫报道了！”
说出这番话的时候，加利亚尼感觉到一阵轻松，总算是甩掉了一个大麻烦，既然亚特兰大人喜欢小丑，就送给他们好了。加利亚尼甚至都没看到租借申请上那一条附加的优先买断条款，这也成了他日后被AC米兰球迷诟病的一大罪状。
AC米兰工作人员的效率非常快，他们当天就和亚特兰大方面达成了协议，因为这笔交易是曼多利尼极力要求的，亚特兰大方面寸步不让，不肯讨一分钱薪水，好在之前加利亚尼已经有了安排，AC米兰方面也没有坚持，就签订了一份租借合同。
新赛季迪甘将前往亚特兰大效力，租借期限为一年，同时亚特兰大享有优先买断的权利，代价是五十万欧元。
也就是说，只要他们愿意，一个赛季之后，他们随时都能以五十万欧元的价码，得到迪甘，当然那也需要迪甘同意才行。
就这样，迪甘被AC米兰像是扔垃圾一样的，甩给了亚特兰大，当迪甘知道这个消息的时候，他倒是没觉得自己被侮辱了，甚至如果可以的话，他还希望这样的侮辱能多来几次，越多越好。
他唯一的念头就是一一妈的！撞大运了！
content_en:
Chapter 7 Good luck
There are only three days left before the start of the new season. Deegan is very aware of his situation. Even in the youth team, facing a bunch of kids two or three years younger than him, he mostly gets looks of contempt. It is obvious that that game has already created his legend.
Alanio, the director of the youth team, seems to regard him as a transparent person. It's no wonder that he has talented players in his 20s and 30s, so he can't care about a piece of trash like him.
Deegan was quite calm. Every day when people were training, he would run laps on the side. In the words of Pawlowski, the top talent in the youth team, this silly big man had lost hope in football and planned to switch careers to train for marathons.
Others can say whatever they like. As long as Degan knows what he is doing, it is OK. After these days of training, he feels that he has slowly adapted to this body. Although it is unlikely that the speed will return to the 10.8 seconds of 100 meters in his previous life, there is no problem in maintaining it at 11 seconds.
During this period, AC Milan was also trying its best to recommend him to other teams, as if he felt that if he stayed in Milanello, he would pollute the air. Deegan knew that these were all Kaka's help, and he hoped that his younger brother's football career could continue.
It's a pity that even teams in the C-2 league are not willing to give him a chance to try out. All the replies are: Give me money, I don't want that trash.
Deegan has made up his mind that he will not waste his best years in AC Milan's youth team. With a five-year contract, when he escapes, he will basically be able to say goodbye to his football career. What will he be able to brag to his son about?
Hey! Boy! My dad once played football in an AC Milan uniform, and even made a big fool of himself.
Forget it! In that case, Degan would rather cut off his descendants than have his son regard Kaka as an idol in the future, even if Kaka is his brother.
Deegan has already made plans. During the winter break, he will go to teams around the world to look for trial training opportunities. He believes that by then, it will not be a problem to return to the level of his previous life.
It's not that he hasn't thought about staying here, staying in Milan, and conquering this place through his own efforts, but that is really difficult. During this period, the Milan youth team played three games, and he didn't even make the squad. Even the group confrontations within the team were not his part. It was obvious that everyone no longer had any expectations for him.
Except of course Kaka.
"Rhode! I have an opportunity here. Peggia is willing to give you a chance to try out. If you can pass their assessment, you will be theirs in the new season!"
When Kaka said these words to Deegan, there was a hint of excitement on his face. During this period, he had begged many people for Deegan's matter, and now he finally got the result.
"Peggia!? What kind of team is that!?"
Kaka was stunned for a moment, then said with some embarrassment: "It's a team from the C-League 2. They were just relegated last season, and this team is still very capable!"
Deegan smiled and said: "They seem to have refused before, how could their conscience find out this time?"
Of course, Kaka cannot tell Deegan that the current owner of that team is Gattuso's father, as that will only hurt Deegan's self-esteem even more.
Seeing that Kaka was silent, Deegan also guessed something: "Thank you! Ricardo! I know you have begged many people during this period because of my affairs, but I still have to refuse. That team is not worthy of me!"
Hearing this, Kaka got angry without warning, frowned and said: "Rhode! You can't be too ambitious in life. You should be aware of your current situation. Of course, I believe in your strength, but even if you are Pele, Zico, or Socrates, you can't be too ambitious."You need a chance to show yourself, are you ready to wait forever for Milan to give you a chance, Rhodes! Wake up, after so many years, when did the coach of Milan look down? I very much hope that we can fight side by side in the same team, so go out for a walk and make a name for yourself outside, so that AC Milan has to take you seriously! "
Deegan did not argue with Kaka like he did with Bosque last time. He could feel that Kaka really cared about him, but he still shook his head and said: "Ricardo! Listen to me, I said I want to go my own way, no matter how difficult this road is, please let me go on my own! "
Kaka knew that no matter how much he said it, it was useless. Deegan had changed. He was no longer the younger brother who obeyed him. He now regretted it. If he had not taken the initiative to bring Deegan to Italy, he might have made a name for himself in Sao Paulo.
Just when everyone thought Deegan was finished, he could only hang out at Milanello until his contract expired, or simply until Kaká left. He will be like a vampire, taking an annual salary of one million euros from AC Milan but doing nothing.
But at this moment, things took a turn for the worse. Looking at the fax handed over by his assistant, Galliani couldn't believe his eyes.
"Atalanta wants to loan Deegan, Kaká's younger brother! ? "
Galliani's eyes were full of doubts. Only when his opponent nodded did he believe that his eyes were right.
Why is this?
Galliani's big bald head is full of question marks.
Is there anything special about Deegan? Although AC Milan has its own pride, there is one thing he has to admire about Atlanta, and that is the training camp in Bergamo, where almost the best young talents in Italy are concentrated. Pazzini, Montolivo, Lazzari, these names have attracted the attention of countless people.
In comparison, AC Milan's youth training camp has been lackluster in recent years. Since becoming the Five Little Tigers, they have never added any fresh blood to the first team.
Rubbing the bridge of his nose, Galliani said: "I agree to their loan application. There is no need to bargain with them. We will pay all of Degan's salary, that's right!" Stop by the youth team and inform Deegan that he can report to Bergamo! "
When he said these words, Galliani felt a sense of relief, and finally got rid of a big trouble. Since Atlanta people like clowns, give them to them. Galliani did not even see the additional buyout clause on the loan application, which became a major crime that he was criticized by AC Milan fans in the future.
The efficiency of the AC Milan staff was very fast. They reached an agreement with Atlanta on the same day, because this deal was what Mandolini strongly requested. Atlanta refused to give in and refused to ask for a penny of salary. Fortunately, Galliani had already made arrangements before, and AC Milan did not insist on it and signed a loan contract.
In the new season, Deegan will go to Atlanta to play for a one-year loan period. At the same time, Atlanta has the right to buy out first at a cost of 500,000 euros.
In other words, as long as they are willing, they can get Deegan at any time for half a million euros after one season. Of course, that also requires Deegan's consent.
In this way, Deegan was dumped by AC Milan like trash to Atlanta. When Deegan knew the news, he didn't feel that he was insulted. If possible, he even hoped that such insults could happen as many times as possible. The more the better.
His only thought was - Damn it! Good luck!
